title: HammetDungeon01 - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 4 NPCs from HammetDungeon01.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by HammetDungeon01 (HammetDungeon01.esm).

Install this if HammetDungeon01.esm is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
